validation.summary: The candidate is exceptionally close to the reference. The layout, styling, and complex scroll-driven animations are implemented very well, including a robust dynamic SVG generation approach for the strikethrough effect. However, there are a few minor animation and behavior details that need adjustment to perfectly match the reference video, specifically the sequencing of the strikethrough lines and the trigger area for the sticky list.
strengths: Excellent use of GSAP and dynamic SVG path generation to handle the complex Problem/Solution strikethrough animation responsively.
High visual fidelity with accurate typography, spacing, and color token usage.
Clean, modular HTML structure with well-organized Tailwind classes.
Graceful degradation and fallback logic included for animations.

issues.title: Strikethrough lines animate simultaneously instead of line-by-line
issues.observed: In the Problem/Solution section, all horizontal SVG lines begin drawing at the exact same time (position parameter `0` in the GSAP timeline).
issues.expected: The lines should draw sequentially (line-by-line) as the user scrolls, matching the reference video choreography.
issues.fix_instructions: Update the GSAP timeline loop for the paths to stagger their start times. For example, use `tl.to(path, { strokeDashoffset: 0, ease: 'none', duration: 0.5 }, index * 0.15);` instead of starting them all at `0`.

issues.title: Sticky features highlight area is too narrow
issues.observed: The IntersectionObserver for the StickyFeatures list uses a `rootMargin` of `-45% 0px -45% 0px`, which only highlights items when they are in the exact middle 10% of the viewport.
issues.expected: The requirements specify the item should highlight when within the middle 30% of the viewport height.
issues.fix_instructions: Change the `rootMargin` in the IntersectionObserver configuration to `-35% 0px -35% 0px`.

issues.title: Missing logo icon
issues.observed: The header logo is purely text ('Ease').
issues.expected: The reference features a distinct geometric/leaf icon next to the text.
issues.fix_instructions: Add a simple placeholder SVG icon (e.g., a stylized triangle or leaf shape) next to the 'Ease' text in the header logo link.

patch_instructions: In the `<script>` block, locate the `initSVGDrawing` function. Find the `paths.forEach` loop where the GSAP timeline animations are added. Change `tl.to(path, { strokeDashoffset: 0, ease: "none", duration: 1 }, 0);` to `tl.to(path, { strokeDashoffset: 0, ease: "none", duration: 0.5 }, index * 0.15);` (ensure you add `index` to the forEach callback parameters).
In the `<script>` block, locate the IntersectionObserver setup for `.cap-item`. Change `rootMargin: "-45% 0px -45% 0px"` to `rootMargin: "-35% 0px -35% 0px"`.
